name: Warm Low-pass
description: Soften upper harmonics without a pronounced resonant peak.

name: Dark Drone
description: A low cutoff at 300 Hz for a subdued, bass-rich drone.

name: Gentle High-pass
description: Reduce sub-bass buildup below 80 Hz in layered textures.

name: 50 Hz Notch
description: A relatively narrow dip centered at 50 Hz to attenuate hum.

name: Resonant Sweep
description: A resonant low-pass; connect a slow LFO to cutoff and leave headroom.

name: Vocal Resonance
description: Isolate a midrange band near 900 Hz for vowel-like coloration of rich input.

name: Narrow Band
description: Extract a narrow band from noise or a harmonic-rich oscillator.

name: Moving Notch
description: A broad midrange notch ready for slowly modulated cutoff.
